scenario.description: A respiratory therapy supervisor must place the hospital's one available overnight float respiratory therapist between two units and finalize the bedside monitoring schedule and alternate coverage for the unit that does not receive the float therapist.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one available overnight float respiratory therapist for the 19:00-07:00 shift.
shared_context.S2: The float therapist must be assigned to either the North Unit or the South Unit, and both units have requested overnight respiratory therapy coverage.
shared_context.S3: Renee makes the binding assignment and records the overnight coverage plan.
shared_context.S4: At the daily 16:00 respiratory staffing huddle, Renee routinely checks with the covering pulmonologist and staffing coordinator before finalizing the overnight roster.
shared_context.S5: The huddle follows a routine in which each consulted role gives a concise report before Renee records the final roster.

PF1.text: The North Unit patient in room N418 was placed on high-flow oxygen and requires an in-person respiratory therapist assessment beginning at exactly 22:00, with repeat assessments every two hours through 06:00. On the overnight roster, the North Unit respiratory therapy start-time field for this assessment schedule must be recorded as 22:00, not the 19:00 shift start; Dr. Patel confirmed this order during the afternoon review, but it is not yet on the overnight roster.

PF2.text: South Unit coverage can be maintained without the float therapist because Jordan, the South Unit day-shift respiratory therapist, agreed to cover 19:00-23:00 and Maya from Unit 3 agreed to cover South from 23:00-07:00; Morgan confirmed both agreements directly with the therapists.

acceptance_conditions: The float respiratory therapist must be assigned to the North Unit.
The North Unit respiratory therapy start-time field must record 22:00 for the first in-person assessment.
North Unit respiratory therapy assessments must be scheduled every two hours.
The South Unit alternate coverage must specify Jordan covering 19:00-23:00 and Maya covering 23:00-07:00.
The North Unit escalation requirement must be explicitly cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: 'Jordan' in decisions['south_unit_coverage_plan'] and '19:00-23:00' in decisions['south_unit_coverage_plan'] and 'Maya' in decisions['south_unit_coverage_plan'] and '23:00-07:00' in decisions['south_unit_coverage_plan']

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed N418 requirement changes the float assignment to North Unit, changes the roster start-time field from the 19:00 shift start to exactly 22:00, and fixes the assessment interval at exactly two hours.
The two confirmed therapist agreements change South's alternate plan from unspecified coverage to Jordan's 19:00-23:00 coverage followed by Maya's 23:00-07:00 coverage.
